atoms.b: The Maya believed in at least 200 ((++gods_and_goddesses men_and_women)), each one controlling a different part of life.
The ((++king sing)) of the Maya gods was Itzamná, the god of creation. He was one of the oldest gods and created humans and writing.
Itzamná's wife, Ix Chel, was the goddess of the ((++Moon Sun)) and fertility. Maya women prayed to her if they wanted to have children.
atoms.sound: Itzamna’s wife, E-shell, was the goddess of the Moon and fertility. Maya women prayed to her if they wanted to have children.

atoms.b: The god of rain was called Chaac. ((++Farmers Fighters)) worshipped him so that he would bring rain for their crops.
Yum Kaax was the god of ((++nature televisions)). His name means Lord of the Forest, and he would help people hunting for food.

instruction.text: Complete the picture of a Maya tattoo.

feedback.finish: The Maya even had a god of tattooing called Acat! Tattooing was an important part of their worship, and the Maya had tattoos of things such as the gods and numbers.

atoms.b: had both a good and a bad side.
atoms.sound: The Maya believed their gods had both a good and a bad side.
